fields.profile_id: The selected semantic profile in this immutable pair.

fields.role_surfaces: Screened map keyed by an active role name for this particular frozen instance. Values are ordered arrays of nonempty, individually licensed equivalent surface forms for the one intended operand, candidate collection or display.

FINDING.admission: Require every public surface for this role to denote only its selected bound operand. A collection role may name the collection as a whole. A list of surfaces offers equivalent descriptions of the same operand, never competing operands or values.
FINDING.surface_form: An unambiguous approved public name of the finding supported in both displayed observations.

OPTION_A.admission: Require every public surface for this role to denote only its selected bound operand. A collection role may name the collection as a whole. A list of surfaces offers equivalent descriptions of the same operand, never competing operands or values.
OPTION_A.surface_form: Neutral public reference to the first option in the frozen comparison presentation.

OPTION_B.admission: Require every public surface for this role to denote only its selected bound operand. A collection role may name the collection as a whole. A list of surfaces offers equivalent descriptions of the same operand, never competing operands or values.
OPTION_B.surface_form: Neutral public reference to the other option in the frozen comparison presentation.

public_request.projection: Assemble exactly the fields of the active profile from the verified public context. Each surface array is the exact nonempty projection of its licensed role. Keep the private answer designation, reference sets, provenance and test fixtures outside the generator request. A neutral candidate label may appear as a permitted public operand even when it is also the correct choice. Never mark it as the answer or disclose which alternatives are supported.

wording.intent: Select the earlier of two named displayed observations of the same finding in one video.
realization: Ask for one earlier observed frame. Both named options must remain equally available as responses.
Preserve the same finding, the same two options, the earlier direction and positive observed status.
Changing the direction to later, asking for all anchors, locating additional evidence relative to a reference, or asking for the first appearance in the entire video changes the operation.
Do not infer onset, persistence, change in the lesion, duration, causation, normality or disease progression.
wording.prompt: Write one natural English question asking which of two displayed frames showing the supplied finding occurs earlier in the same video. Name the supplied finding and both neutral choices, preserving their supplied option order. Use your own sentence structure. Return only a JSON object with one key, question. Choose one exact spelling from the supplied finding surfaces. Their order does not indicate preference. Use the spelling that fits the question naturally.

output_contract.unit: One freely worded English question per candidate. Apply the variation policy when multiple eligible wordings are requested.

language_fixtures.purpose: Offline task regression on complete wording under the declared synthetic presentation and private truth. Gold labels do not establish runtime performance.

context_1.private_fixture_assumptions: Synthetic temporal presentation from one video. Panel B and panel A both visibly contain a verified polyp. Assume the query term polyp is licensed for that single class and role. The answerer's public context maps panel B to source frame 160 and panel A to frame 120. The generator receives only the licensed finding and the neutral choices in the order B, A. The independently frozen answer is the unit for panel A.

context_2.private_fixture_assumptions: Synthetic temporal presentation from one video. Panel B and panel A both visibly contain a verified polyp. Assume the query term polyp is licensed for that single class and role. The answerer's public context maps panel B to source frame 160 and panel A to frame 120. The generator receives only the licensed finding and the neutral choices in the order B, A. The independently frozen answer is the unit for panel A. Reading order on the screen is B then A, the reverse of acquisition order. Neither chronology nor layout is the default meaning of first in this presentation.

cases.text: Between panel B and panel A, which frame showing the polyp was recorded earlier?
cases.reason: One earlier-of-two observed order request with symmetrical neutral options.

cases.text: Of panel B and panel A, which polyp frame occurs later?
cases.reason: The temporal direction has been reversed.

cases.text: Of panel B and panel A, was the polyp observed earlier in panel A?
cases.reason: Proposes one option as the winner and requests yes/no verification.

cases.text: Between panel B and panel A, which frame shows when the polyp first developed?
cases.reason: Disease onset cannot be derived from the first of two observed positive anchors.

cases.text: Between panel B and panel A, which frame showing the polyp is first?
cases.reason: First can refer to display position or acquisition order here. Both operands resolve, but the requested ordering cannot be recovered uniquely.

variation_policy.scope: one request for one frozen semantic instance
variation_policy.before_sampling: Require successful preflight for the exact frozen instance and its screened public request. The configured budget bounds generator calls for that one request.
variation_policy.per_attempt: Request one freely worded candidate using the same frozen public request and validate the original response. Keep the deduplication state, prior candidates, fixture data and private evidence outside the generator request.
variation_policy.eligibility: Count a candidate only when the complete selected checks authorize its wording and its validated text is bound to the same instance. Only accepted candidates enter the deduplication set.

distinct_key.use: Detect equivalent spellings within this sampling request. Preserve the first validated original text for each key. Persistent corpus deduplication and export use their own common-engine checks.

dispositions.accepted: Record the unique original and count it toward the requested number.
dispositions.duplicate: Record an accepted validation with a duplicate sampling outcome. Consume one attempt and leave the accepted count unchanged.
dispositions.fatal_abort: Stop immediately. Close this batch without releasing any previously accepted candidates. Retain all actual attempt outcomes in the trace.

stop_conditions.target_reached: Stop as soon as accepted_count equals requested_count.
stop_conditions.attempt_budget_exhausted: Stop at the finite budget when accepted_count is still below requested_count.
stop_conditions.blocked: Preflight or another mandatory dependency failed. A preflight block makes zero calls.

report.accepted: Return validated candidates with the original question, candidate_question_sha256 and audit_id. Compute the question digest from the exact original UTF-8 bytes.
report.limits: Separate the wording-selection result from any subsequent authorization to export.
